_metadata.rule_1_compliance: Every number here traces directly to results/*.json or data files

error_1_tautology_index_vs_demographics_.description: Table IV demographics AUROC (0.5801, 0.5180, 0.4473, 0.5527) differed from earlier TI runs (0.5910, 0.4846, 0.4460, 0.5558).
error_1_tautology_index_vs_demographics_.root_cause: Demographics AUROC was generated by benchmark.py (5-seed 5-fold CV), whereas TI was computed in an earlier 3-seed run in tautology_audit.py.

child.instability_reason: Clean AUROC (0.4473) is below chance (0.50), causing numerator to exceed denominator.

error_2_leaky_vs_infold_combat_paired_di.description: Displayed AUROCs differed by 0.0096 (0.6689 - 0.6593), but paired test reported delta = 0.0156.
error_2_leaky_vs_infold_combat_paired_di.root_cause: In site_analysis.py, run_paired_harmonization_tests passed meta_df['target'].values in original row order, while predictions_map had predictions sorted site-by-site, causing paired deltas to be calculated with misaligned labels.

recomputed_values.conclusion: No detectable difference at sample size N=854 across 20 sites.

error_3_permutation_test_p_value_resolut.description: Permutation test p-value reported as p=0.0000 below finite sample resolution.
error_3_permutation_test_p_value_resolut.root_cause: Calculated as mean(null >= obs) without the +1 continuity correction.

error_4_logistic_regression_accuracy_ran.description: Paper claimed LR achieved 99.4--100% accuracy, omitting Adolescent cohort.
error_4_logistic_regression_accuracy_ran.root_cause: Adolescent repeated 5x10 CV accuracy was 95.55% +/- 5.47% (95% CI [84.21%, 100.00%]), which was omitted from the summary range.

thesis_1_behavioral_tautology.summary: Reported ML performance on behavioral questionnaires is inflated by deterministic label leakage from items.

thesis_2_scanner_generalization_gap.summary: Random cross-validation on multi-center neuroimaging inflates performance due to scanner hardware fingerprint memorization.

thesis_3_leaky_combat_inflation.summary: At the full sample size (N=854, 20 sites), deliberately leaky ComBat does not yield a statistically detectable inflation over in-fold ComBat.

thesis_4_uncertainty_aware_decision_supp.summary: Calibration and conformal prediction provide valid empirical coverage and meaningful clinical triage across allocation versions, but scanner shift induces site coverage variability.

controlled_site_probe.interpretation: Phenotypic variables alone achieve site decoding above the 19.91% majority baseline. Connectomes retain 73.54% site decodability even after regressing out age, sex, FIQ, motion, and diagnosis strictly in training folds. This represents site-associated information (scanner RF coils, acquisition parameters, recruitment protocols) rather than hardware signatures alone.

deduplication_audit_summary.participant_identifier_check: No participant identifiers exist in Adult, Adolescent, Child. Toddler has sequential integer Case_No. Removed rows are identical records, not verified duplicate participants.
